hypotheses.P1_operator_profile_beats_embedding: Operator-profile categories exceed exact-embedding categories by at least 0.05 joint KL recovery.
hypotheses.P2_operator_profile_is_competitive_with_: Operator-profile categories are within 0.03 joint KL recovery of human categories.
hypotheses.P3_operator_profiles_are_split_stable: Independent operator-profile clusterings have frequency-weighted NMI at least 0.60.
hypotheses.P4_operator_profile_behavior_is_split_st: The two operator-profile ontologies differ by at most 0.05 joint KL recovery.
hypotheses.P5_hybrid_improves_operator_profile: Combining embedding and operator profiles improves recovery by at least 0.03.
hypotheses.P6_a_causal_learned_ontology_is_predicti: At least one routing/operator/hybrid ontology reaches 0.70 native top-1 agreement.
